description: Push a pulled bundle (a .harvest.zip or a fetched directory) to the user's GitHub repo in one commit. The token is per-call only — never stored, never logged. New repos are created private by default.

branch.description: Branch to push to. Defaults to the repo's default branch.

bundle.description: Absolute path to a .harvest.zip (from harvest.pull) or a fetched files directory.

create_if_missing.description: Create the repo if it doesn't exist (private by default).

pack_name.description: Pack name for the commit message, e.g. 'Vision Mix v1'.

path.description: Path prefix inside the repo. Defaults to the repo root.

token.description: GitHub personal access token, per call. Falls back to the GITHUB_TOKEN env var. Never stored.

name: harvest.push
